lee_design: Quick design QA: small follow-up on the time-range picker + sampling UI for the latency dashboard. lee_design: Observed confusion: users think the sampling % applies to the global timepicker. Need clearer labels. ashley_eng: Suggestion: label the toggle 'panel sampling' and add helper text 'applies to this panel only'. priya_pm: Agree. Also can we persist per-panel? product prefers per-panel so dashboards can differ. maria_a11y: Accessibility nits: helper text must be programmatically associated with the toggle (aria-describedby). Focus ring missing currently. samir: UX nit: move sampling toggle next to presets (not inside the overflow menu) so it's discoverable. Add a tiny badge when enabled: 'sampling: 10%'. lee_design: Draft copy for helper: 'Panel sampling: percentage of requests used to compute metrics for this panel.' Short alt: 'Percent of requests sampled for this panel.' ashley_eng: Implementation plan: persist under localStorage key `redwood.dashboard.{dashboardId}.panel.{panelId}.sampling` and fire analytics `latency.sampling.change`. Also add unit test for focus + aria. priya_pm: Analytics: include props {dashboard_id, panel_id, old_value, new_value, user_tier}. maria_a11y: Tooltip ARIA example: ```
Percent of requests sampled for this panel.
``` lee_design: OK I'll update the comp and add the badge in Figma. uxbot: please create task. uxbot: Created task INFR-3720 and attached comp https://figma.com/file/pnl123 lee_design: Thanks all 44d
